newsitem.title: JAPAN: NOK profit rise seen larger than forecast - paper.
newsitem.headline: NOK profit rise seen larger than forecast - paper.

text.p: NOK Corp's parent current profit in the year to March 31 is expected to grow 32 percent on a year-on-year basis, a larger rise than the company has forecast, a Japanese business daily said on Friday. The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that the company's parent current profit in 1996/97 would be about six billion yen.
The expected rise is due to robust sales of car and electronics parts, the paper said.
NOK officials were not immediately available for comment, but the company has said that its parent current profit in 1996/97 will be 5.8 billion yen, up 28 percent from the previous year.
